## 使用情境 / Use case

你希望解決什麼橋牌分析或操作問題？
What bridge-analysis or usability problem should this solve?

## 建議功能 / Proposed feature

請描述理想的輸入、操作與輸出。
Describe the desired input, workflow, and output.

## 替代做法 / Alternatives

目前是否有替代方法？它有什麼限制？
Are there existing workarounds, and what are their limitations?
